name: protoc

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Protocol Buffers compiler — provides built-in Python and pyi codegen invoked by buf via protoc_builtin
installHint: Install via the OS package manager (e.g. `apt install protobuf-compiler`, `brew install protobuf`). Vrooli's setup uses the same. v25+ is required so `--python_out` and `--pyi_out` are both built in.
notes: Used as `protoc_builtin: python` / `protoc_builtin: pyi` in packages/proto/buf.gen.yaml; bytes may vary by minor version, so the proto-codegen byte-stability gate (`make check`) will catch upstream upgrades.
